headline: Bajel Projects secures order worth up to ₹300 crore from Tata Power
hook: New Mumbai grid contracts for Bajel
summary: Bajel Projects has bagged an EPC order from Tata Power to supply and install 220 kV GIS substations in Salsette and Powai, Mumbai. The contract carries an 18-month execution timeline from the date of the purchase order. For retail investors holding Bajel Projects, this major win reinforces order book visibility in the transmission and distribution segment.
why_it_matters: Order book bolsters near-term revenue visibility for Bajel Projects.

headline: Tata Power's solar subsidiary TP Solar reports high production numbers for Q2
hook: Scaling output in a competitive clean energy market
summary: TP Solar manufactured 1 GW of solar modules and 0.9 GW of cells during the second quarter of the financial year. This brings the company's total production for the first half to 2 GW of modules and 1.8 GW of cells. For an Indian retail investor, this signals steady operational scaling in Tata Power's renewable energy manufacturing arm amid India's push for domestic solar capacity. Increased output can improve revenue visibility for the company's green energy segment.
whats_next: Q2 financial results announcement from Tata Power
why_it_matters: Higher domestic manufacturing output supports Tata Power's clean energy revenue growth.
winners_losers: Tata Power gains / high-cost rivals hurt
